_about: The islands' perks (core/perk_state.gd; game/perk_machine.gd is the machine). limit = most perks carried at once (the boss's perk power-up ignores it); all are lost when you go down. Each perk: name, price in points, island + at [x, z] from that island's middle (its machine; it faces the island's middle), color, desc (shown at the machine), and its numbers. Machines work once the power is on. Every name, price and number is the director's to change.

second_wind.name: Second Wind
second_wind.desc: Help a teammate up twice as fast. Alone: once a run you get back up by yourself.

blast_proof.name: Blast Proof
blast_proof.desc: Landing from high up throws a shockwave.

steady_hand.name: Steady Hand
steady_hand.desc: Headshots hit half again as hard; steadier from the hip.

deep_pockets.name: Deep Pockets
deep_pockets.desc: Ammo pools hold half again as much, magazines a fifth more.

run_and_gun.name: Run and Gun
run_and_gun.desc: A finished reload makes you a fifth faster for 2 s.

scavenger.name: Scavenger
scavenger.desc: Some kills hand you rounds for the gun in hand; power-ups last half again as long.

backdraft.name: Backdraft
backdraft.desc: An enemy that hits you is set alight and thrown back (every 5 s).

thick_skin.name: Thick Skin
thick_skin.desc: Armour counts double; burning, poison and slow last half as long.

cold_blood.name: Cold Blood
cold_blood.desc: The first shot after 3 s without firing hits twice as hard.

lucky_strike.name: Lucky Strike
lucky_strike.desc: One kill in ten pays double; power-ups drop a quarter more often.
